text:
Alex: Kicking off Q2->Q3 hosted capacity planning thread. Need a concrete recommendation (buy/lease/spot mix) for GPUs to cover expected seasonal surge. Decision target: 2026-05-01. Please include assumptions (GPU-hours, lead times, region constraints, rough $).

Mira: Sharing projections from the forecast model (assumptions inline). Short version: baseline growth + seasonal spike -> ~2.1x monthly GPU-hours next quarter vs current.
```
Assumptions:
- Current hosted monthly GPU-hours: 120000
- Expected next-quarter monthly GPU-hours: 260000
- Peak concurrent GPUs (A100-eq) needed at 95th pct: ~420
- Baseline steady-state concurrent GPUs: ~180
- Surge headroom target: +240 GPUs
```
Numbers are model outputs (traffic mix: chat 55%, completions 30%, embeddings 15%). Model run id: forecast-2026-04-12-08.

Dennis: Procurement notes: new A100 orders -> ~12-14 weeks from PO to delivery for on-prem racks (vendors + customs). Lease vendors can furnish in 2-3 weeks but min term is usually 3 months. Spot/market instances available immediately but volatile in eu-west during daytime. Pricing ballpark: buy ~ $75k-$95k/GPU (list variance), lease ~ $2.6k-$3.8k/GPU/month (rack+power+remote-hands), spot cloud ~ $1.0-$2.5/GPU-hour depending on region and instance type.

Jordan: Region constraints to call out: eu-west has constrained bare-metal supplier slots for summer (we saw capacity throttling last year). If we need EU capacity guarantee we must prebook or use cloud reserved capacity (costly). Also networking note: our 100Gb inter-rack uplinks hit saturation at ~380 concurrent generation workers; if we add GPUs without uplink upgrades we'll see tail latency regressions.

Ana (Finance): High level budget guidance: finance comfortable with <$2.5M incremental capex this quarter, or equivalently ~$600k/month additional opex. Preference: lean toward leases to avoid large upfront capex, but if buy gives >9-12 month ROI we can consider partial capex. Need final cost estimate by 2026-04-28.

OpsBot: forecast-runner finished: projected peak GPU-hours next quarter = 2,720,000 (total), monthly avg = ~906,667, peak-day = 95,000 GPU-hours. Confidence: medium.

Mira: Quick proposal (hybrid):
- Buy 70 A100-eq as baseline (covers ~30% of steady demand). Lead time ok but gives cheaper unit cost long-term.
- Lease 140 A100-eq for 6 months to cover predictable growth + part of surge. Shorter lead time, monthly opex predictable.
- Maintain spot pool up to 90 GPUs for burst/overflow; use region-aware routing (failover to us-west for eu-west shortages).
Rationale: reduces capex, gives predictable baseline, leaves flexibility for Q4 decisions.

Dennis: Rough cost calc (very rough):
- Buy 70 * $85k = $5.95M capex (we'd likely finance or amortize)
- Lease 140 * $3k/mo * 6mo = $2.52M opex over 6 months
- Spot assume 90 * avg 10h/day * 90 days * $1.5/hr ~= $1.1M variable
If capex budget is constrained (Ana's $2.5M), we can reduce buy to 30-40 units and increase lease count. Also consider buy-on-lease contract (convertible lease).

Jordan: Operational follow-ups:
- If we buy racks, we must schedule interconnect upgrade in datacenter (2-3 week install) before spinning up >350 GPUs in a cluster.
- AZ/region distribution plan: prefer 60% us-west, 30% eu-central, 10% apac for hosted API (latency+customer mix). Must prebook eu-central capacity or push burst to us-west.

Ana (Finance): Given the cost math Dennis posted, full-buy is >our stated capex ceiling. I'm ok with a hybrid with buy reduced to 30-40 units (~$2.6-3.4M) + leases to fill the rest. Need break-even / ROI calc for buy vs lease on a 12-month horizon.

Mira: Alternate conservative mix to fit capex: buy 40, lease 170 (3-6 month flexible), spot 60. Projection impact: latency SLOs preserved, monthly opex higher but capex within Ana's ceiling.

Dennis: Vendor ops note: ask vendors for "short lead" pool pricing and for convertible leases (option to buy at reduced price at month 3). Also get expedited shipping quotes and customs pre-clearance to shave ~2 weeks.

Alex: Asking for final recommendation by 2026-04-28: please reply with one-line recommended mix + one-line risk summary + one-line cost snapshot. I'll consolidate and present to execs.

Jordan: My one-liner: Recommend hybrid (buy 40 / lease 160 / spot 60); risk: eu capacity & network uplink saturation; cost snapshot: est 40-buy capex ~$3.2M + lease ~ $2.88M over 6 months + spot ~$0.8M.

Mira: My one-liner: Recommend buy 50 / lease 140 / spot 50; risk: procurement lead-time slippage; cost snapshot: est capex ~$4.25M + lease ~$2.52M/6mo.

Dennis: My one-liner: Recommend buy 30 / lease 200 / spot 60 (min capex path); risk: higher opex and potential supplier price increases; cost snapshot: capex ~$2.55M + lease ~$3.6M/6mo.

Ana (Finance): My one-liner: lean to buy 30-50 + leases to fill remainder; risk: if demand falls, lease penalties; cost snapshot: approve up to $2.5M capex now, need lease burn plan.

Alex: Thanks all — looks like consensus on hybrid with capex-constrained buy. I'll draft slides with three scenarios (conservative, balanced, aggressive) and run ROI calc for each. Please drop any last-minute inputs here before EOD PST. :thumbsup:

Mira: Adding one last ops detail: add caching + prefix reuse plan to reduce peak GPU-hours by ~12-18% — helps shrink required surge capacity.

Jordan: Noted — will include network upgrade quote in the slides (ETA 10 business days).

Dennis: I'll ping vendors for convertible lease quotes and expedited options tomorrow.

Ana (Finance): I'll put provisional $2.5M capex hold in place and prep accounting treatment.

OpsBot: ticket-created: CAPEX-REQ-3245 assigned to Ana (Finance) due 2026-04-20.

Alex: Great — thread closed for now, but keep updates here.
